params.caption: 🎮 No darts in GTA 6 — Rockstar says it ran out of time to do it right Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC that darts (in the last two GTAs) and bowling (GTA 4) were left out because the team couldn't make them "feel proper". Since Red Dead Redemption 2, minigames are built as activities that extend the core mechanics — like pool with real physics, weightlifting and free-roam basketball.
